title: Expressing Wishes and Preferences
summary: Talking about dream trips, plans, and preferred travel experiences.
whyItMatters: Shared travel plans work when people state priorities, compare options, and identify where they can compromise.

mentalModel.title: Preference plus reason
mentalModel.content: State what you prefer and the practical or personal reason behind it.

mentalModel.title: Compare before deciding
mentalModel.content: Evaluate two options using the same criteria such as cost, time, comfort, and activities.

ruleBlocks.title: State the ideal clearly
ruleBlocks.content: Use Ich würde gern, Ich hätte gern, or Am liebsten würde ich.

ruleBlocks.title: Compare matched criteria
ruleBlocks.content: Use lieber, besser, günstiger, ruhiger, and wichtiger with a reason.

ruleBlocks.title: Find a workable combination
ruleBlocks.content: Keep essential needs and trade flexible preferences.

examples.de: Am liebsten würde ich im Herbst nach Italien fahren.
examples.en: I would most like to travel to Italy in autumn.

examples.de: Ich würde lieber mit dem Zug fahren, weil wir dann kein Auto brauchen.
examples.en: I would rather travel by train because then we do not need a car.

examples.de: Das Hotel ist zwar teurer, aber es liegt direkt am Bahnhof.
examples.en: The hotel is more expensive, but it is directly at the station.

commonMistakes.correct: Ich fahre lieber ans Meer. / Ich mag das Meer lieber.
commonMistakes.reason: Lieber must attach clearly to the preferred action or object.

commonMistakes.wrong: Repeat a preference without explaining it.
commonMistakes.correct: Add the criterion or reason that matters.

comparisons.summary: The theme provides planning categories and constraints.
Hätte and wäre gern express polite wishes for things and states.
